title: Missing-information register
description: What we do not have, why it matters, and the concrete action that would obtain it. A gap is only closed when a file exists in this repo with rows and sources — not when we describe the plan. Status classes: NOT-FOUND (we looked and the official path does not exist), NOT-ATTEMPTED (needs a decision or money), NOT-FETCHED (source is known to be official and reachable, we simply have not opened it yet).

columns.label: Why we do not have it

rows.dataset: Historical opening and closing NFL point spreads, totals and money lines, point-in-time
rows.needed_for: Backtest of origination, CLV measurement, detectable-edge calculation, parlay correlation vs market price
rows.why_gap: Betting lines are not NFL-published content and there is no free official archive; the league's official betting data feed is exclusively distributed.
rows.action: Request quotes from two licensed line vendors; require point-in-time snapshots, a documented close definition, and the right to retain and compute derived statistics.

rows.dataset: Historical final inactive lists (per game, per club) with timestamps
rows.needed_for: Fitting P(play) by designation, and the Sunday re-price the brief's injury-tracking requirement depends on
rows.why_gap: No verified official endpoint was identified in this pass; the expected league paths 404 or redirect.
rows.action: Verify the league's gameday operations documentation and club pages; if only club-side publication exists, instrument 32 club collectors with a per-club schema hash alert.
rows.owner_class: Agent (research) — needs a host to run the collector

rows.dataset: Official injury-report archive for prior weeks and seasons, in bulk
rows.needed_for: Training the availability model; measuring how often Questionable actually plays, by position and day
rows.why_gap: The public page exposes season (back to 1965) and week selectors, so an archive appears reachable, but we captured only one chunk of one week and have no documented bulk endpoint.
rows.action: Probe for the underlying data endpoint the week selector calls; if none, write a cursor-preserving HTML collector that stores raw captures and the chunk/page cursor used.

rows.dataset: Snap counts, participation snaps and lineup-by-play position data
rows.needed_for: Quantifying what a backup actually replaces — the difference between 'starter out' and 'starter out and 62 snaps redistributed to a third-stringer'
rows.why_gap: Play-level and tracking data are the licensed part of the NFL data estate (Next Gen Stats via the exclusive distributor); nothing verifiable is free.
rows.action: Price the NGS/Genius tier we actually need, or decide to build our own snap-share proxies from public play-by-play we are permitted to keep — and document the proxy's bias.

rows.dataset: Drive-level game logs (start field position, plays, time, outcome) for a multi-season window
rows.needed_for: Totals origination from first principles: expected points per possession and possessions per game
rows.why_gap: Not derivable from the injury/roster pages we verified; needs either licensed play-by-play or a self-built log from official gamebooks we are permitted to ingest.
rows.action: Decide the collection route (licence versus self-built from official game statistics), then write the schema and a backfill job with raw-response retention.

rows.dataset: Depth charts (who is the 2nd, 3rd, 4th stringer) in a machine-readable, stable form
rows.needed_for: R-15 and R-16 as briefed — backup deficiency on both sides of the ball
rows.why_gap: The league site has no verified depth-chart endpoint: the expected path returned the official 404 page in this session, and the transactions path redirected to the team directory.
rows.action: Two options, both recorded as tasks: parse the 32 club sites (official but club-operated, 32 layouts), or construct a shadow chart from eligibility rules plus our own snap-share history and label it estimated.

rows.dataset: Weather observations and forecasts at kickoff, per venue, from a named public source
rows.needed_for: Totals and completion-rate adjustments; the published precipitation-favourite interaction
rows.why_gap: We have not verified a federal weather endpoint in this pass, and the rule 'no feature without a source' means it cannot enter the model yet.
rows.action: Verify the National Weather Service / NOAA public data endpoints and their licensing, record field names and update cadence, then add a feature row to models.json.

rows.dataset: Measured market hold by market family (singles, team props, player props, parlays, live)
rows.needed_for: Break-even hurdle per family, which sets the edge threshold and therefore bet volume
rows.why_gap: Regulators publish the underlying data (Illinois CSV monthly detail with a Sport Detail report; New York weekly and monthly Excel statewide and per operator) but we have not opened them; two plausible Nevada landing paths returned 404, so no Nevada number is published here.
rows.action: One scripted pull of the Illinois and New York report sets into data/market_hold.csv with the report period in the filename; refresh monthly at the regulator's own lag.

rows.dataset: A verified current text of the injury-report policy (deadlines, short weeks, Monday games, designation rules)
rows.needed_for: The weekly release calendar and the meaning of every field we ingest
rows.why_gap: We verified the Competition Committee's definitional revision and the report's live structure, but not the current operational memo containing exact filing deadlines, which is a league document we have not located in a citable form.
rows.action: Locate the current policy text (league document, CBA exhibit, or club-published policy) and record its date; until then, treat times as observed-from-the-page, not as quoted policy.

rows.dataset: Current-season confirmation of roster rules (IR return minimum, designations count, gameday active count)
rows.needed_for: The next-man-up eligibility engine; a wrong roster constant silently misprices every replacement case
rows.why_gap: The official roster-FAQ article we verified is written around the 2022 league year; the 2026 rulebook exists on the operations site but its rule text was not opened in this pass.
rows.action: Open the 2026 rulebook and the current CBA summary on the operations site; store the clause text with its effective date.

rows.dataset: Current CBA and league rules on what clubs may say about injuries and availability, to third parties
rows.needed_for: Knowing whether any 'insider lineup' channel we might be offered is lawful to receive at all
rows.why_gap: The policy direction is clear from the league's own pages (non-public information sharing is prohibited and monitored), but the exact current text governing clubs and third parties is not something we should paraphrase.
rows.action: Read the league's published integrity framework and the CBA article on information; write the constraint into engine/compliance.py as a hard rule, not a guideline.

rows.dataset: Our own bet-log and settlement ledger, with timestamps and price-at-bet
rows.needed_for: Everything the leaderboard ranks, every gate it evaluates, and any future audit of whether the system actually works
rows.why_gap: The schema exists in engine/leaderboard.py but there is no populated log; no bets have been placed or simulated at scale in this repo.
rows.action: Start logging immediately in paper mode: one row per decision including every abstention, because the abstentions are what let us measure selectivity.

rows.dataset: Jurisdictional rules for the state(s) we operate in (age, permitted markets, promos, tax)
rows.needed_for: R-04 legality posture, and the market universe we may quote
rows.why_gap: Jurisdiction is unknown (Q-04); and market rules differ by state even among licensed operators.
rows.action: After the owner names the state, read that state's regulator rules page and record the three numbers we care about: minimum age, permitted prop categories, tax/hold implications.

rows.dataset: Legal opinion on the prize competition (free entry, skill-based, eligibility, payout rails)
rows.needed_for: R-34 — whether the leaderboard may pay anything
rows.why_gap: Outside an agent's remit; we can design constraints, not provide counsel.
rows.action: Brief counsel with the draft rules and the entry mechanism; keep the prize non-cash until answered.

rows.dataset: Operator account terms on automated order placement and data use
rows.needed_for: Whether any part of this pipeline may execute without a human, which the brief's 'no manual input' requirement implies
rows.why_gap: Account terms are operator-specific, change without notice, and are not something to summarise from memory.
rows.action: Read each partner operator's current terms on automated tools and third-party data; assume 'not permitted' until proven otherwise.

rows.dataset: Prop-market definition catalogue (what counts as a reception, a rush attempt, a sack; half vs full settlement)
rows.needed_for: Player-prop combos — the highest-variance, most definition-sensitive part of the brief
rows.why_gap: Definitions live in filed house rules per operator and per version; we verified only the correlation and SGP clauses, not a full definitions table.
rows.action: Build a per-market definition diff across the three official partners, keyed to the rule version, and refuse any prop whose definition we have not read.

rows.dataset: Historical injury-report-to-line-move pairs (for measuring, not asserting, the market's reaction)
rows.needed_for: Testing whether the report delta carries information the market under-reacts to, which is the whole injury-signal thesis
rows.why_gap: Needs GAP-01 and GAP-03 simultaneously: line ticks joined to report snapshots with aligned timestamps.
rows.action: After the line licence lands, one join job; publish the reaction coefficient with a confidence interval, and let it be insignificant if it is insignificant.

rows.dataset: A live-run environment: host, schedule, secrets, alerting, raw-capture storage
rows.needed_for: R-33 and the promise of no manual input; also the audit trail regulators and any future reviewer expect
rows.why_gap: This sandbox has no outbound access to the league or regulator hosts, so collection can be written and unit-tested but not executed; and we are not permitted to provision infrastructure on an owner's account.
rows.action: Provision one scheduled runner with a dead-man switch; retain raw responses for one season; print last-run status on every table.
